title: Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan Settlement-Timing Pricing of Bank Transfers
content:
**Fee schedule note — Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan next-business-day transfers to a bank account: the settlement-timing fee.**

A weekday is the day of the week of today's date, the transfer's entry date, and the transfer's confirmation time is its requested time, Eastern Time.

The settlement-timing fee sets the fee charged by when the worker confirmed the transfer:

- confirmed after the **17:00** submission cutoff on a Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday or Thursday, the transfer settles a business day later and is charged the tier's next-business-day bank fee less **0.50**;
- confirmed after the cutoff on a Friday, or on a Saturday or Sunday, it settles two or more business days later and is charged the tier's next-business-day bank fee less **1.00**;
- otherwise it is charged the tier's next-business-day bank fee.

The fee charged is never below zero.

| Day of the entry date | Confirmed at or before 17:00 | Confirmed after 17:00 |
|---|---|---|
| Monday to Thursday | bank fee | bank fee less 0.50 |
| Friday | bank fee | bank fee less 1.00 |
| Saturday or Sunday | bank fee less 1.00 | bank fee less 1.00 |

*Hypothetical, on Paystride Access Premier, whose next-business-day bank fee is 0.99 USD:* confirmed on a Tuesday at 17:00 exactly, 0.99 USD; on a Tuesday at 17:05, 0.49 USD; on a Friday at 18:30 or any time on a Sunday, 0.99 less 1.00, which is below zero, so 0.00 USD.
